DBADD.syntax: DBADD parent element; fewer than two operands returns 400; trailing operands are ignored
native_typed_containers: missing scalar fields read as 401 Object is null and remain OID-addressable after DBSET
DBADD.persistence: cmqttd stores the incomplete typed record independently of numeric address maps and atomically materializes it after compulsory fields are set

DBCOPY.syntax: DBCOPY source destination; fewer than two operands returns 400; trailing operands are ignored
native_same_project: Address and TagName read as null until DBSET
after materializing a copied Application root, its copied Group/Level remain unaddressable because their Address and TagName are also null
native_cross_project: copied Application, Group and Level tags are immediately addressable in the destination project
DBCOPY.persistence: cmqttd recursively retains pending same-project descendants and materialized cross-project descendants across restart

DBCREATE.manual: replaces the current tag database with a representation of connected C-Bus networks and C-Gate implementation; unspecified compulsory values use [default]
DBCREATE.native_generated_project_defect: build 2001 emitted an intermediate 408 Project not found followed by final 200 or returned 500 on the generated-project TagDB path
DBCREATE.cmqttd: generation-guarded NET SYNC precedes an atomic fresh-OID snapshot; no stale or synthetic inventory is accepted

DBNEW.manual: replaces the current project tag database with a blank Installation/Project database
DBNEW.native_generated_project_defect: build 2001 returned 500 after creating the blank database; DBTAGLIST subsequently returned only the project tag
DBNEW.cmqttd_repair: performs the documented clear atomically and retains only a non-durable configured-interface runtime shell

DBUPDATE.syntax: DBUPDATE network-or-unit [UnitDelete]; no target is 400; native ignores later words
DBUPDATE.manual: refreshes one network or unit from physical configuration; exact UnitDelete removes database units absent physically
DBUPDATE.cmqttd: refreshes the target through NET SYNC, merges physical identity while retaining database OID/name, and commits atomically

DBVERIFY.manual: zero or more 345 Difference rows; 200 when equal; final 408 Verify failed with difference count when unequal
DBVERIFY.cmqttd: refreshes live networks through NET SYNC and compares presence plus nonblank type, firmware and serial identity
